A '''citrine crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The citrine crystal was a yellow brown in color, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Accelerate Healing]]. The [[Miner/Legends|miner]] [[Ansan Talam]] discovered a citrine crystal while prospecting on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The cult leader [[Garuk]] had a golden amulet with three tasar crystals, one of which was a citrine crystal. [[Valjak]], a Tasari member of the [[Kiana]], had a citrine crystal inset on his right bracer.<ref name="J15" />
